what: L0 spot checks of the corpus against the anasofiadias page images of Sloane MS 3189 (folio = leaf + 8), read by eye on enlarged crops. The images (rights unclear) and the crops are not included; the readings of whole row segments are left out because they reproduce the edition's text. Counts and short cell references only.. Kelley writes a secretary hand: c looks like a modern r, r like x or z, e like a reversed 3, h like a long-tailed s, g like y; readings below allow for this.
reader: Claude agent (not a palaeographer); each reading is of a whole row segment in context
